title: SocratesExport
description: Schema for Socrates query results exported for ingestion by mbr_insights_agent.py. All fields optional except where noted. Spend values are directional.

bd1_6_actuals.description: BD1to6AI actuals for the reporting period. Fractional (e.g. 0.72) or whole number depending on product. Source: MBR-3 or MBR-1.

bd1_6_target.description: BD1to6AI OKR target for the reporting period. Typically set in Atlas KR or shown on Optimal deck. Source: deck or Atlas.

bd1_6_prior_period.description: BD1to6AI actuals from the prior period (prior month for MBR, prior week for TOFU). Used to compute MoM or WoW delta.

spend.description: Total media spend for the period in USD. Directional only; mark as approximate when presenting. Source: MBR-1 or TW-1.

cac.description: Customer acquisition cost in USD for the period. Source: Optimal deck or derived from spend / bd1_6_actuals.

ltv_to_cac_ratio.description: LTV to CAC ratio as a multiplier (e.g. 35.0 means LTV is 35x CAC). Source: Optimal deck.

cpbd1_6.description: Cost per BD1-6 in USD (spend / bd1_6_actuals). Source: MBR-1 or TW-1 derived column cpbd1_6_per_k divided by 1000.

paid_share.description: Paid channel share of total BD1-6 as a fraction (e.g. 0.72 = 72%). Source: MBR-4 or TW-3.

organic_share.description: Organic channel share of total BD1-6 as a fraction. If omitted, agent derives as 1 - paid_share. Source: MBR-4 or TW-3.

data_lag_flag.description: Set to true if the query results include data from the last 7 days, which will be understated due to BD1-6 bake lag. Agent will surface a warning in output.

channels.description: Per-channel breakdown. Include all material channels. Source: MBR-1 (paid) or TW-2 (all channels).

channel.description: Exact channel string as it appears in Socrates. Use verified channel strings from paid.md or gtm.md.

bd1_6.description: BD1to6AI volume for this channel in the period.

spend.description: Media spend for this channel in USD. Directional. Null for organic channels.

cpbd1_6.description: Cost per BD1-6 for this channel in USD. Null for organic channels.

wow_delta.description: Week-over-week change in BD1-6 as a fraction (e.g. 0.05 = +5%). Use for TOFU weekly reports.

mom_delta.description: Month-over-month change in BD1-6 as a fraction (e.g. -0.03 = -3%). Use for MBR reports.

share_of_total.description: This channel's share of total BD1-6 as a fraction (e.g. 0.45 = 45%).
